# braze_catalog (Resource)

Manage a Braze catalog and its field schema.

~> Changing the catalog's name, description, or fields replaces it and deletes
all contained items. Add the catalog to each managed item's
`lifecycle.replace_triggered_by` to recreate those items when the catalog is
replaced. Back up items managed outside Terraform before applying a replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braze_catalog" "products" {
  name        = "products"
  description = "Product information for personalized messages"
  fields = [
    { name = "id", type = "string" },
    { name = "name", type = "string" },
    { name = "active", type = "boolean" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) The catalog description.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Ordered catalog fields with unique, non-empty names. The first field must be `id` with type `string`. Supported types are string, number, boolean, time, array, object, and geo. Any change requires replacement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `name` (String) The catalog name, unique within the configured Braze workspace. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

### Read-Only

- `num_items` (Number) The number of items in the catalog.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the catalog was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)

## Import

Use the provider configuration for the workspace that owns the object.

```shell
terraform import braze_catalog.products products
```

With Terraform 1.12 or later, an identity import block can also be used:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 or later. Configure the provider for the owning workspace.
import {
  to = braze_catalog.products
  identity = {
    name = "products"
  }
}
```
